notes.title: Update 1.03: Panhard, faster game pace and new icons
notes.notes:
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/capsule.png[/img]

New Unit:
Panhard: A scout vehicle with auto-cannon, a very good raid unit.
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/panhard.png[/img]

Balance:
Reduce the HP of base guard tower and firebase from 2500 to 1500.
Reduce the damage of base guard tower from 15 to 12.
Slower the attack speed of base guard tower.
Reduce the building speed of main structures from 30 sec to 20 sec.
Reduce the HP of flak truck from 450 to 425
Reduce the cost of ATV from 700 to 600.
Reduce the cost of Hummv from 600 to 500.
Increase the damage of T-95 Black Eagle from 210 to 225.
Reduce the Rapid Repair cool down time from 150 sec to 120 sec.

Bug fix:
Fix the bug that the base guard tower can be cancelled and return funds.
Fix the bug that when vehicles are attacking a building while on attack moving, it can not switch attack target by manual order.

Feature:
New capsule and icon for the game.
More help text and icons on building platform, mercenary camps and flag points.

notes.title: Hotfix Version 1.01
notes.notes:
After receiving feedbacks from players, I made a hotfix version.

Fix:
1. Improve the ground vehicle pathfinding.
2. Fix some bugs that infantry can not garrison into some neutral buildings.
3. Debuff  the gurad tower, -25% damage, -20% attack range, -20% F-35 airsupport damage.
4. Increase the damage of Su-25 Strike from 350 to 400.

Thanks to all players, making RTS games is much harder than I expected, but I will keep polishing the game:)

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/ArmorClash_2016-06-19_19-06-19-38.png[/img]

notes.title: Rifleman, Missile infantry and Sniper will be in next version
notes.notes:
As players suggested, I made 3 different types of infantries. 

Rifleman use automatic rifle, can upgraded with a rifle grenade.
Missile infantry can launch rockets to attack ground and air enemies.
Sniper, is an unique unit, need "Special Force" command ability to unlock him. The sniper can kill other normal infantries in one shot. He can also attack vehicles and buildings by calling airforce to bombard the target.
